units: <cite ref="Sukkah 10b">Succ. 10ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>צריך א׳</he> must be tied together.
<cite ref="Sukkah 10b">Ib.</cite> <he>הותר אִגְדּוֹ</he> if the tie of the Lulab became loosened.

<cite ref="Eruvin 101b">Erub. 101ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>בניטל באִגְדּוֹ</he> (a. twice <he>אִיגְ׳</he>, Rabb. in D. S. a. l. <he>באוּגְדּוֹ</he>) when the door pin is handled by pulling the cord knotted to it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:1:7">Y. Ter. II, 41ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ שנטמא</he> a bunch of herbs that became unclean.
